answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprint Rule: each identity’s action sequence is hashed into a per-epoch fingerprint stored in a quartz-sealed ledger. A new epoch’s fingerprint must match the prior one within a fixed divergence bound, enforced at the wharf gateway before task admission. Sybils splitting into many fresh identities pay full recomputation and divergence-proving cost per identity each epoch, since continuity cannot be inherited or copied from a haven of dormant accounts.
